globalAttributes.name: t-if
globalAttributes.description: Conditionally mount this node. Pair with t-else-if / t-else.

globalAttributes.name: t-else-if
globalAttributes.description: Else-if branch of a t-if chain.

globalAttributes.name: t-else
globalAttributes.description: Else branch of a t-if chain.

globalAttributes.name: t-show
globalAttributes.description: Insert or remove this node from the real DOM.

globalAttributes.name: t-repeat
globalAttributes.description: Repeat this node. `item in list` or `(item, index) in list`.

globalAttributes.name: t-for
globalAttributes.description: Alias of t-repeat.

globalAttributes.name: t-key
globalAttributes.description: Stable key for t-repeat reuse.

globalAttributes.name: t-html
globalAttributes.description: Set innerHTML from an expression.

globalAttributes.name: t-text
globalAttributes.description: Set textContent from an expression.

globalAttributes.name: t-ref
globalAttributes.description: Expose this element on $refs.

globalAttributes.name: t-pre
globalAttributes.description: Skip compiling this subtree.

globalAttributes.name: t-once
globalAttributes.description: Bind this subtree once, then freeze.

globalAttributes.name: t-cloak
globalAttributes.description: Hide until compiled. Pair with [t-cloak] { display:none }.

globalAttributes.name: t-bind
globalAttributes.description: Spread an object of attributes onto this node.

globalAttributes.description: Named slot filler on a custom tag.

globalAttributes.description: Class binding: string, array, or { name: cond }.

globalAttributes.name: t-bind:style
globalAttributes.description: Style binding: object of CSS properties.

globalAttributes.name: t-bind:disabled
globalAttributes.description: Boolean attribute binding.

globalAttributes.name: t-on:input
globalAttributes.description: Input handler.
